title: lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/CMakeLists.txt lists nonexistent schc_session_authority.c (breaks Zephyr build)
description: Found during spec-coverage sweep 03-adaptation (R-03-042/044/045/048 C evidence, 2026-09-09): lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/CMakeLists.txt:18 lists source file schc_session_authority.c, which does not exist on disk. Any Zephyr build including the lichen SCHC subsystem fails at CMake configure time. The session-authority sources that DO exist are schc_session.c, schc_session_table.c, schc_authority.c (with tests lichen/tests/schc_session, schc_session_table, schc_authority). Fix: either remove the dangling entry or rename the intended file; verify with a native_sim or host build of the subsystem. Related hygiene in the same subsystem, optionally folded into this fix: dead constants SCHC_MAX_ACK_REQUESTS / SCHC_RETRANSMISSION_TIMEOUT_S / SCHC_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_S / SCHC_RCS_BYTES (lichen/schc.h:106-109 — engine uses its own SCHC_FRAGMENT_MAX_ATTEMPTS) and the stale standalone test lichen/tests/schc_failure_tracker/main.c which calls a superseded 3-arg tracker init API and cannot compile against the current header (the twister variant src/main.c is current). This defect blocks the C work tracked by l1qw.3.7.6 (authenticated bounded Zephyr SCHC session authority). See docs/spec-coverage/03-adaptation-flagged.md F8.
